working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Adipose tissue' cluster(s) (Saavedra et al. 2023, Figure 3a), dissected adult male thoraces, control genotype.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any fat cell (FBbt:00046052) that is part of some adult thoracic fat mass (FBbt:00053710).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Adipose tissue' (Fly Cell Atlas-based). The adipose tissue (fat body): its cell type, the fat cell; the samples are thorax only, so the thoracic fat cell (curator, after the FBbt #2218 review of the adult fat terms, FBbt 2026-11-02).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053714 adult thoracic fat cell (exact match).
